querystring.select: SELECT  C.CUST_NO AS CustNo, C.CUST_ID AS CustId, C.CUST_NAME AS CustName, RM.DESCR AS MrGenderCode, CONCAT(CP.BIRTH_PLACE, ' ', CONVERT(NVARCHAR,CP.BIRTH_DT,106)) AS BirthPlaceDt, CONCAT(RMID.DESCR ,' ', C.ID_NO ) AS IdTypeNo, CONVERT(date, C.ID_EXPIRED_DT) AS IdExpiredDt, C.TAX_ID_NO AS TaxIdNo
querystring.from: FROM dbo.CUST AS C WITH(NOLOCK) JOIN dbo.CUST_PERSONAL AS CP WITH(NOLOCK) ON C.CUST_ID = CP.CUST_ID JOIN dbo.REF_MASTER RM ON RM.REF_MASTER_TYPE_CODE = 'GENDER' AND RM.MASTER_CODE = CP.MR_GENDER_CODE JOIN dbo.REF_MASTER RMID ON RMID.REF_MASTER_TYPE_CODE = 'ID_TYPE' AND RMID.MASTER_CODE = C.MR_ID_TYPE_CODE
